find_stereo_correspondences: find pixel correspondences between two stereo camera views using depth pointmaps and camera matrices
transform_secondary_to_anchor: transform a secondary camera pointmap into the anchor camera coordinate system using extrinsic matrices
pack_stereo_inputs: pack stereo image pairs and depth pointmaps into SegDataSample objects for model training
pack_test_stereo_inputs: pack a single stereo image as anchor or secondary input for inference with metadata
visualize_stereo_correspondences: visualize matched pixel correspondences between two stereo images with colored point markers
